observed_behavior: A pair target created after the existence check is overwritten, and rollback unconditionally removes an earlier target even when it was independently changed.
expected_behavior: Preliminary review and Outcome pairs publish atomically create-only, preserve every competitor, return the correct collision code, and roll back only writer-owned bytes.
impact: Review evidence or implementation Outcome history can be silently replaced, invalidating create-only revisions and the audit chain.

reproduction.symptom_oracle: Both the second-target competitor and the independently changed first target remain byte-identical while the writer returns its requested collision code.
steps: Stage a two-file create-only pair with both destinations initially absent.
Independently change the first destination after its publication and create the second destination immediately before its publication.
Run once with OUTCOME_EXISTS and once with PRELIMINARY_REVIEW_EXISTS.
reproduction.sample: Before the fix, the two new subtests were the only failures in the 22-test workflow suite because KnowledgeError was not raised; the reviewer probe reported competitor_bytes_preserved=false.

root_cause.summary: _write_pair_create_only implements create-only as a non-atomic exists-check followed by os.replace and unconditionally unlinks committed targets during rollback.

next_action: Implementation executor uses atomic no-replace file publication and atomic ownership retirement for rollback, then reruns workflow, Windows/Linux full verification and fresh review.
